# Copilot instructions for SpendWise

- Read `DOCs/BRD.md`, `DOCs/SRS.md`, and `DOCs/SFS.md` before changing behavior.
- Preserve FR/BR/NFR identifiers in implementation and test names.
- Run `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm test`, and `npm run test:functional`.
- Never commit credentials or real user expense data.
